title: Doctor Goldsmith
author: James Baldwin
summary: 哥尔德斯密斯医生把一盒钱当作“药”，送给穷困的病人一家。
publicDomainBasis: Published 1896 by the American Book Company; author James Baldwin (1841–1925). Public domain in the United States and in China (author's life plus 70 years).

paragraphs.en: There was once a kind man whose name was Oliver Goldsmith. He wrote many delightful books, some of which you will read when you are older.
paragraphs.zh: 从前有一位心地善良的人，名叫奥利弗·哥尔德斯密斯。他写了许多令人愉快的书，其中一些，等你长大后会读到。

paragraphs.en: He had a gentle heart. He was always ready to help others and to share with them anything that he had. He gave away so much to the poor that he was always poor himself.
paragraphs.zh: 他有一颗温柔的心，总是乐于帮助别人，与人分享自己的一切。他施舍给穷人的东西太多，以至于自己总是很穷。

paragraphs.en: He was sometimes called Doctor Goldsmith; for he had studied to be a physician.
paragraphs.zh: 人们有时称他“哥尔德斯密斯医生”，因为他曾学医，想当一名医生。

paragraphs.en: One day a poor woman asked Doctor Goldsmith to go and see her husband, who was sick and could not eat.
paragraphs.zh: 一天，一位贫苦的妇人请哥尔德斯密斯医生去看看她丈夫，她丈夫病了，吃不下东西。

paragraphs.en: Goldsmith did so. He found that the family was in great need. The man had not had work for a long time. He was not sick, but in distress; and, as for eating, there was no food in the house.
paragraphs.zh: 医生去了。他发现这家人非常穷困。男人已经很久没有工作了。他不是生病，而是愁苦；至于吃的，家里一点食物也没有。

paragraphs.en: "Call at my room this evening," said Goldsmith to the woman, "and I will give you some medicine for your husband."
paragraphs.zh: “今晚到我住处来一趟，”哥尔德斯密斯对妇人说，“我给你丈夫拿点药。”

paragraphs.en: In the evening the woman called. Goldsmith gave her a little paper box that was very heavy.
paragraphs.zh: 晚上，妇人来了。哥尔德斯密斯递给她一只沉甸甸的小纸盒。

paragraphs.en: "Here is the medicine," he said. "Use it faithfully, and I think it will do your husband a great deal of good. But don't open the box until you reach home."
paragraphs.zh: “这就是药，”他说，“按时用，我想它会对你丈夫大有好处。不过，到家之前别打开盒子。”

paragraphs.en: "What are the directions for taking it?" asked the woman.
"You will find them inside of the box," he answered.
When the woman reached her home, she sat down by her husband's side, and they opened the box; What do you think they found in it?
paragraphs.zh: 妇人回到家，在丈夫身边坐下，两人打开盒子。你猜他们在里面发现了什么？

paragraphs.en: It was full of pieces of money. And on the top were the directions:
paragraphs.zh: 盒子里装满了钱币。最上面放着用法说明：

paragraphs.en: "TO BE TAKEN AS OFTEN AS NECESSITY REQUIRES."
Goldsmith had given them all the ready money that he had.
paragraphs.zh: 哥尔德斯密斯把自己身边所有的现钱都给了他们。
